mechanism_plan.selected_construction: Use a diagonal acoustic braid with exposed conditioning and refinement surfaces separated by visible space. The refined acoustic ribbon reaches a separate decoder; the original frame strip bypasses the core and meets the waveform only at final alignment.

geometry_requirements.description: The conditioning surface and refinement surface are separate open structures with visible state transformation between them. Smooth noise particles become a connected acoustic ribbon; neither stage is an enclosing tube.
Encoded video, optional guidance, initial noise and returned acoustic state meet only through their declared entries; no guide or video trace becomes the acoustic output itself.
The acoustic return leaves the refinement surface and lands on its declared conditioning entry. It never returns into the original frame strip.
The original frame order remains visibly intact along a separate bypass to temporal alignment, independently of visual encoding.
The compressed acoustic ribbon passes through a separate visible decoder before becoming a waveform and reaching alignment.
Noise is smooth blank particle geometry, not writing marks, surface texture or pseudotext. Guidance tokens show no positive or negative symbols outside the allowlist.
